checks.pendingFormatter: pins hidden view until completion; new text survives recreation
checks.pendingSave: real disk save finishes; a newer hidden edit remains dirty
checks.syntheticCompositionEvents: view stays pinned through hidden composition end; released after returning visible and hiding again
checks.visual: exact text, multi-selection, undo/redo counts, real fold, 18000 px scroll and Find/Replace data preserved
checks.liveDiagnosticRows: One actual syntax diagnostic before hide, zero while parked, one after resume

limits: Full public chapter texts and C++ listings read; images not visually inspected, examples not compiled. Not whole books.
Synthetic composition lifecycle is not an OS IME certification.
Linux source desktop only; no macOS/Windows, packaged installer, model or native-language bridge measurements.
PSS sampled after diagnostic renderer GC, excludes external model/runtime and display-server/driver memory; not normal peak RAM.
Repeated-resume phase can increase process memory; no universal savings, flat heap or general speed claim.
The final repeat did not reproduce exploratory PSS savings; lower retained DOM is the reproducible result.
